devastator.operator_profile_precision: Native Calc_Matmul/Calc_SDPA and other operator probes allocate torch.float16; this is retained for BF16 workloads as well.
devastator.normalization_probe: Native Calc_LayerNorm profiles torch.nn.LayerNorm. Actual training model uses audited RMSNorm.
devastator.communication: Native single operation/message-size communication fit from 8-GPU NCCL-tests; retain native formula and topology approximation.
devastator.training: Real training dtype, dimensions and normalization are audited independently; predictions remain native approximations.

galvatron.profile_precision: Native model profiler uses workload mixed_precision.
galvatron.cp: Native search serializer drops CP: fixed to 1 for native full search; roundtrip evidence stored separately.
galvatron.embedding_sdp: Selected embed_sdp mapped explicitly to existing runtime vocab_sdp field.
